info.title: BugSnag - Session Tracking API
info.description: Report sessions of your application to compare release stability scores.

servers.description: For organizations with projects on app.bugsnag.com
For organizations with projects on app.bugsnag.smartbear.com

202.description: The payload has been accepted for processing. BugSnag does not process requests synchronously so this response is sent when the payload has successfully been received and queued for processing.

400.description:
The request was invalid. Possible reasons include:
- Missing header
- Empty body
- Body too large (the limit is 1MB)
- Failed to parse payload body

405.description: A method other than POST was used on the sessions endpoint (e.g. GET)

errors: Please POST to this URL. For documentation, see https://developer.smartbear.com/bugsnag/docs/bugsnag-session-tracking-api

post.description: Report the start of a session. Multiple session start events can be batched into a single request.

parameters.name: Bugsnag-Payload-Version
parameters.description: The version of the payload. Currently 1.0

parameters.name: Bugsnag-Sent-At
parameters.description: e.g. 2017-01-01T15:00:00.000Z - The time (in ISO 8601 format) that the session payload is being sent.

device.userAgent: Mozilla/5.0 (Macintosh; Intel Mac OS X 10_12_1) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/54.0.2840.98 Safari/537.36

sessions.description:
Details of the sessions that have started. Multiple sessions on the same app and device can be batched together to minimize network traffic.

  This field is required unless `sessionsCounts` are being used.

sessionCounts.description:
Summary counts of the number of sessions started in a minute.

  This can be used instead of `sessions` for server side applications to simply provide a session count summary and reduce the size of the payload being sent (making it have less of a footprint on the server side application).

Application.description: Information about the running app that the session started on

type.description: A specialized type for the application, such as the name of the worker queue, GUI toolkit, or web framework in use

releaseStage.description: The release cycle stage in which the error occurred, such as "production", "development", or "beta"

version.description: The version number of the application which started the session

bundleVersion.description: The [bundle version/build number](https://developer.apple.com/library/content/technotes/tn2420/_index.html) of the application (iOS/macOS/tvOS only)

codeBundleId.description: A unique identifier to identify a code bundle release when using tools like CodePush (mobile only)

Device.description: Information about the host device running the application that the session started on

hostname.description: The local network name of the device that the session started on (server only)

id.description: A unique identifier for the device.

manufacturer.description: The manufacturer of the device (mobile only)

jailbroken.description: Whether the device has been jailbroken (mobile only)

osName.description: The operating system name (mobile and server only)

osVersion.description: The operating system version (mobile and server only)

userAgent.example: Mozilla/5.0 (Macintosh; Intel Mac OS X 10_12_1) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/54.0.2840.98 Safari/537.36
userAgent.description: The user agent of the browser that the session started on (browser only)

RuntimeVersion.description: The versions of the relevant runtimes, languages and/or frameworks for the platform.

dotnetClr.description: Version of .NET Common Language Runtime (.NET only).

osBuild.description: Build number of the OS (iOS/tvOS/macOS only).

reactNative.description: Version of React Native (React Native only).

unityScriptingBackend.description: The Unity scripting backend - Mono or IL2CPP (Unity only).

Notifier.description: Information about the notifier used to send the session information

name.description: The name of the notifier sending the session information

url.description: The URL of the repository containing the notifier code

id.description: A unique identifier of the session. This can be anything that uniquely identifies the session for your project. It is used to track Errors against the Session that they occurred in.

startedAt.description: The time (in [ISO 8601](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601) format) at which the session started

The time, to the earliest minute, at which the sessions represented in the `sessionsStarted` count started.
The time should be in [ISO 8601](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601) format.

sessionsStarted.description: The number of sessions started in the minute represented by the `startedAt` time

User.description: Details of the user that started the session

id.description: A unique identifier for the user who started the session

tags.name: Session
